content: Ne Napauli, napungwa ku nhwalo gwa kunhenge Kilichitu Yecho. Mmii pamba pamonga na nnongo gwito Timocheyo. Tunnyandikii mwe makoche bhito ma Filimone, nhenga lihengo nnyito,
na lilongo lya bhando lilinyeketii Kilichitu lilikongina kajhino na mwenga nnombo gwito Afiya na kwa nkomana ngondo nnyito Alukipo.
Ninyope umbone nu uteeke kuhumii kwa Chapanga Tate gwito na Bhambo Yecho Kilichitu.
Upalo na kihobholelo cha Filimone
Machiko ghoha puninnyopa Chapanga ninkomboka mwe ma Filimone nu kunchenguu Chapanga gwango,
nhwalo nnyohine chimuhobholela Bhambo Yecho na chimapala bhando bha Chapanga bhoha.

Ninnyope kwa Chapanga kupala kihobholelo chino chenie chimihenga pamonga na twenga kwa Chapanga, kijhingii nkate hake na nhoto kubhehe na uhotolo gwa kumanya hake na mota yoha itupata kwa kulombana na Kilichitu.
Nnongo gwango, lipalano lino linhalalii hake na linneki mwojho! Mwenga mihanganiche miojho jha bhando bhoha bha Chapanga.
Pauli annyopa Filimone ampoke Onechimo
Ku nhwalo gwenio, na nenga nalongo gwino kwa kulombana na Kilichitu, ngahotwi kunnaghalikiya changajhoghopa nhenge chimipala kuhenga.
Nambo nhwalo nimpala, mbaha ninnyope, ndenda naha ihoto kubhehe ne Pauli ng'oime, na ngohe napungwa ku nhwalo gwa kunhenge Kilichitu Yecho.
Yenie ninnyopa muntangatile Onechimo, jwakibha mwanango kwa kulombona na Kilichitu putukibha mu kipungo.
Makacho akibha kilebhenacho, nambo ngohe abhii na lihengo kwa nenga na kwino mwenga hele.
Ngohe nimujhicha kabhele kwino, jwenio ngita mwojho gwango.
Nikapahi atame na nenga, antendele lihengo lende lyu kuntangatii mwe kone mmii mombo mu kipungo, ku nhwalo gwa kwatangachii bhando Lilobhe lya Mbone.
Nambo mbahijhe kunchokolekeya undangatile, nambo nipala nhenge chimipala, yenio nihenga jhe chochoha ade mabhene nnyeketele.
Pange Onechimo natama na mwenga kwa machiko ghandina tugha, abhujha kabhele kwino ntame nako machiko ghoha.

Ngohe jwenio mmanda kabhe jhe, nambo jwenio jwaumbone kuliku mmanda, jwenio ngohe nnongo gwito mu kulombana na Kilichitu. Ambahi nenga na impala mwenga hake, nhwalo jwenio ngita nnyito na nnongo mu kulombana na Bhambo.
Bhahe, anda umona ne kubhehe nalongo bhino ku kulombana na Bhambo, mumpokela Onechimo ngita hela ngaumbokii nenga.
Anda antendi chochoha changanandela, amu abhii na lighambo kwino, nanepa nenga.
Ne Pauli nijhandika namwete kwa lubhoko lwango, naninepa! Mbaijhe nikomboche unnepe ughome gwino.
Bhahe, nnongo gwango, undendela yenio ku kundangatii nenga ku nhwalo gwa Bhambo, ngohe mwe malongo bhango mu kulombana na Kilichitu muhanganiche mwojho gwango.
Nhwalo chakaka ninhobholela, ninnyandikii ghanga, manye nanhenga kupeta ghanga ghuninnobholile.
Pamonga na gheniya, unenganikiye chumbi chukugholoka nhwalo ghu kujhopa kwino ninhobholela Chapanga najhangula, na nenga nanintyangila kwenio.
Nyambuchilo jha kujhomolela
Epafula, mpungwa nnyango ku nhwalo gwa kunhenge Kilichitu Yecho, innyambucha.
Helahela akahenga mahengo bhajhango Maluku na Alichitako na Dema na Luka, na bhene bhinnyambucha.
Umbone gwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu utame pamonga umiojho jhino.
